as_told.title: Lazar says he was inside an alien craft

plain: A man named Bob Lazar says that around 1988 and 1989, at a secret site in Nevada called S-4, he crawled inside one of the craft he was working on. He tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that inside there were three things that looked like seats. A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell, retelling Lazar's story, puts it differently: that Lazar was inside an alien craft from another planet and saw other ones too, without mentioning the seats. If true, it would mean a man has stood inside a vehicle not made by humans.
